title: Screen ad brand model
description: Optional. Anything not declared here is derived: missing colours fall back to photo palette extraction, then to the built-in default theme.

logo.description: Path to a PNG/SVG logo. Relative paths resolve against the brand.json folder first, then --photos.

logoDarkOnLight.description: True when the logo artwork is dark and must be inverted on a dark theme.

theme.description: Dark is the signage default; light is for daylight/window-facing screens. Never mix both on one wall.

colors.description: All values are #RRGGBB. Every pair that ends up on screen is contrast-checked; a failing pair fails the build.

cssFile.description: Vendored @font-face CSS. Defaults to vendor/fonts.css inside the skill.

safeAreaPct.description: Text-safe margin as a fraction of the short edge. 5% is the v1 default.

minContrast.description: WCAG contrast floor for any text. 7 is preferred for body copy.

minTextPx.description: Hard floor for any rendered text at 1920x1080.

maxFlashingHz.description: Photosensitivity limit. The validator rejects any timeline that flashes faster.
